- [FACT] The Wiltern is a beautifully restored art deco theater in Koreatown.
- [FACT] The Troubadour is a legendary club in West Hollywood.
- [FACT] The Roxy Theatre is a Sunset Strip institution.
- [FACT] The Fonda Theatre is a historic theater in Hollywood.
- [FACT] El Rey Theatre is a beautifully restored art deco theater in Miracle Mile.
- [FACT] The Echo is a hip club in Echo Park.
- [FACT] The Regent Theater is a Downtown LA venue.
- [FACT] The Viper Room is a legendary club on the Sunset Strip.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Forum is an indoor arena located in Inglewood, just outside of LA, with a seating capacity of around 17,500.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Forum has hosted some of the biggest names in music and was the former home of the LA Lakers and Kings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Forum is renowned for its exceptional sound quality and electric atmosphere.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for attending a concert at The Forum include:
  - Get there early to soak in the pre-show atmosphere.
  - Be prepared for security checks.
  - The venue offers a mobile-only ticketing system.
  - Parking can be challenging; consider public transportation or ride-sharing.
